svg.title: PCB Backplane Layout — Phycommander I/O Distribution Board
svg.desc: Physical layout of the I/O backplane PCB connecting Arduino Due ATSAM3X8E to 3 DB9 + 3 DB15 + 3 DB25 D-Sub front-panel connectors at 3.3 V, 5 V and 24 V voltage levels. PCB outline 152.28 x 53.30 mm. 1 mm = 10 user units.

g.text: 152.28 x 53.30 mm - 2 layers - through-hole / DIP - see docs/technical/PCB_BACKPLANE_PINOUT.md
PC817 DIP-4 x8 - optoisolators for DIN8..15 (24V input path)
• 9 D-Sub box headers are right-angle 2.54 mm IDC. Cables exit horizontally toward the front panel. Total fill: 147 pins (3x9 + 3x15 + 3x25), all populated.
• Strip A and Strip B carry 50 wires from Arduino Due (sensing + control). Wire by hand per Section 4 of PCB_BACKPLANE_PINOUT.md. 3.3 V is fed IN from the Due via Strip B pin 23.
• Bottom layer: split AGND (under analog pour) / DGND (everywhere else). Joined only at jumper J7 near the analog corner. Layer 2 not shown above.
